content.short: NFT Minter provides files and a tutorial for creating an NFT minting DApp on Ethereum.
content.description: NFT Minter is an open-source, step-by-step blueprint for crafting a decentralized application that mints ERC-standard NFTs. It guides general users through the experience of deploying and interacting with smart contracts on the blockchain, illustrating core concepts of ownership, minting, and on-chain data. For developers, it provides the underlying codebase and a supporting SDK to help assemble an NFT auction protocol, enabling experimentation, prototyping, and rapid iteration in a sandbox-like environment.
content.meta: NFT Minter is an open-source guide to building a decentralized app that mints ERC-standard NFTs. Discover NFT Minter and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
